## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused; no unrelated reformatting or generated output in the diff
- [ ] Tests added or updated (regression test first for defects)
- [ ] Public API changes documented in `README.md` / `docs/` / `type-tests`
- [ ] Skill or application migrations included when interfaces changed
- [ ] `pnpm lint` and `pnpm format:check` pass locally (pre-commit runs them)
- [ ] `pnpm typecheck` and `pnpm test` pass locally (pre-push and CI run them)
